text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- National conference convenes on September 14-15 in Algiers.
- Islamist conference due on Sunday in London was cancelled.
- Government disburses 400 million dinars to help poor students meet school fees.
- Soccer match between Algerian Mouloudia of Oran and Zaire's Vita Club postponed for Saturday.
